description: Cross-validate tr_M(β_Bor) at 50 dps between (1) the closed form (4 + h² − 3h⁴ − h⁶)/(h² + 4) of prop:borromean-markov-trace-closed-form and (2) the Frobenius expansion Σ y_λ · χ^λ using the closed-form Wenzl weights ([4]_q/[2]_q³, 1/[2]_q², 0) of prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights with χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶.  Within-H_3 analogue of markov_pipeline_cross_validator.py (which targets atomic mass-derivation braids).  Fulfils Finding 5 of the audit doc.

data.synthesis_verdict: Two-path cross-validation of the Borromean Markov trace on H_3(q): the closed form (4 + h² − 3h⁴ − h⁶)/(h² + 4) of prop:borromean-markov-trace-closed-form agrees with the Frobenius expansion Σ y_λ · χ^λ using the closed-form Wenzl weights ([4]_q/[2]_q³, 1/[2]_q², 0) of prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights and χ^(2,1)(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ to 50 dps at every sampled q.  This provides empirical evidence for both propositions on the same Borromean witness — the within-H_3 analogue of the atomic-braid Markov pipeline cross-validator.  Disagreement at any sample would have signalled an error in one of: the closed form, the Wenzl-weight closed forms, or the χ^(2,1) polynomial form.
